Name: Meadow Farm Style SVE Premium Farm Buildings (CP)(AT)
Author: Gurrabird
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]
[size=4][CP] and [AT] versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]'s Premium Farm Buildings are designed to coordinate with the look of East Scarp Remastered's Meadow Farm house and other Meadow Farm style buildings and mods. Included are the Premium Barn, Premium Coop and Winery. (CP) version also includes Grandpa's Shed. [/size]


[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

[b][u][AT] Alternative Textures version: [/u][/b]
Download and install/unzip the [AT] version into your mods folder. Once installed, use the paint bucket to select textures. Note that Grandpa's Shed is not in the [AT] version as it isn't a paintable element.

[b][u][CP] Content Patcher version[/u]:[/b]
Download and install/unzip the [CP] version into your mods folder. Once installed, any existing or newly constructed SVE Premium Farm Buildings should have this style. If you have other Content Patcher SVE building mods installed, you may need to select this one specifically, disable the others in the Generic Mod Config Menu or remove them from your mods folder.

[i]Customization options in the Generic Mod Config Menu:[/i]
[list]
[*]Select to disable/enable any of the buildings in this mod if you want to mix and match with other building textures. Default setting is selected/enabled for all buildings.[/*]
[*]Choose Premium Barn lower barn door style (X-brace or Decorative).[/*]
[*]Enable Painting: Select to enable paint masks for paintable buildings: Premium Coop, Premium Barn and Winery.[/*]
[/list][i]About painting:[/i]
[list]
[*]Select to enable paint masks and apply your own colors to these buildings using Robin's Paint menu. Disabling will ignore any paint colors applied with Robin's Paint menu and revert to the default Meadow Farm style colors.[/*]
[*]If you disable this mod or any buildings in this mod after painting your own colors, those colors will usually remain assigned to the unmodded buildings.[/*]
[*]Default setting is painting disabled.[/*]
[*]Painting can be enabled for the Premium Coop, Premium Barn and Winery.[/*]
[*]Not paintable: Grandpa's Shed is not a paintable element.[/*]
[*]Note: When painting is not enabled for a paintable building, the paint menu can still be opened but the ability to paint is disabled.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b]: [/size]
[list]
[*]Alternative Textures / Required only for AT version[/*]
[*]Content Patcher / Required only for CP version[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits and appreciation:[/b][/size]
Lemurkat/East Scarp Remastered for the cool look of the Meadow Farm house that this is based on and permission to post this.
FlashShifter/Stardew Valley Expanded for the SVE premium farm buildings used in this retexture and open asset use permission.
